instant.$description:
No transition: the change happens at once. In milliseconds. Same in every brand, theme and viewport.

Used in:
State changes that must not animate, and every transition when the user has asked for reduced motion. Only in code: no Figma property takes a duration.

Do not:
Do not use it to skip feedback that needs to be seen happening — a dropdown opening takes motion-duration.normal.

fast.$description:
A short transition for small, direct feedback. In milliseconds. Same in every brand, theme and viewport.

Used in:
Hover and pressed states, colour and opacity changes, a checkbox tick, a focus ring appearing. Only in code: no Figma property takes a duration.

Do not:
Do not use it for an element that appears, moves or changes size — a small one takes motion-duration.normal, a large surface motion-duration.slow.

normal.$description:
The default transition length. In milliseconds. Same in every brand, theme and viewport.

Used in:
A small element appearing, leaving or moving a short distance: a dropdown or tooltip opening, a toast sliding in, a popover repositioning, an accordion row expanding. Only in code: no Figma property takes a duration.

Do not:
Do not use it for large surfaces that travel across the screen — a drawer or modal takes motion-duration.slow.

slow.$description:
A longer transition for large surfaces. In milliseconds. Same in every brand, theme and viewport.

Used in:
A modal, drawer or bottom sheet entering or leaving, a page-level panel sliding in. Only in code: no Figma property takes a duration.

Do not:
Do not use it for small controls — they feel sluggish at this length; use motion-duration.fast.

slower.$description:
The longest transition, for deliberate emphasis. In milliseconds. Same in every brand, theme and viewport.

Used in:
A one-off emphasis such as an onboarding highlight or a large illustration settling in. Only in code: no Figma property takes a duration.

Do not:
Do not use it for anything the user triggers repeatedly — a menu or a hover takes motion-duration.fast or motion-duration.normal.
